translations.web: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
translations.bsb: Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
translations.kjv: Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
translations.asv: Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king's son.
